rationale: The whitepaper contains a section dedicated entirely to Data and Control Coupling Coverage (DCCC) that mirrors the requirement text almost exactly. It details the DO-178C constraints, the blindspots of Stage 1 per-leaf-node VQPs, the role of specialized external tools, and the planned Stage 2 integration of these reports into the VC artifact graph.
